keyVerseDR: "Sanctify them in truth. Thy word is truth." (Jn 17:17)

level1.title: Jesus Prays for Us
level1.story: Jesus prayed to His Father for His friends. He asked God to keep them safe and make them holy. Jesus prays for us too!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, keep me holy and safe. Amen.

activity.title: My thank-you prayer
activity.intro: Jesus prayed for His friends. Write a short prayer of thanks.

level2.title: Consecrate Them in Truth
level2.story: At the Last Supper, Jesus prayed, "Holy Father, keep them in Thy name whom Thou hast given Me; that they may be one, as We also are." He said He had kept them safe while He was with them. Jesus prayed that they would have His joy filled in themselves. He asked the Father to keep them from evil, because they are not of the world. Jesus prayed, "Sanctify them in truth. Thy word is truth."
level2.keyLine: Sanctify them in truth. Thy word is truth.
level2.heartTitle: In the World, Not of It
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does 'in the world but not of it' mean?
How does God's word make us holy?
level2.prayer: Father, make me holy in Your truth. Amen.

activity.title: Five-finger prayer
activity.intro: Trace your hand. Pray for someone on each finger.

art.mainBrief: Jesus praying for disciples, protective light around them
